subject: MAP: Security sequencing & DPA retention alignment — LivestreamBank

From: Ethan Price <ethan.price@livestreambank.com>

Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security & retention questions

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the intro call earlier today. As we discussed, we want to make sure the MAP clearly calls out the security/compliance gates and where the DPA retention terms will live so the internal legal and compliance teams can sign off. High-level asks from our side: 

- SOC 2 status and expected timeline for evidence (our auditors need a date window)
- SIG/CAIQ matrix for your hosted and private deployments (we need controls mapped to our requirements)
- Draft DPA with options for EU data residency + 30/90/365 day retention buckets (we'll propose 90 as baseline)
- Any escrow/long-term access options for audit traces if we need them post-contract

Can you respond with a proposed MAP timeline (weeks-to-close), owners for each gate, and any standard evidence artifacts you can attach? Procurement would like something they can attach to our Maturity Review.

Appreciate it — Ethan
Ethan Price

Thanks Ethan — great to meet earlier. Per your ask, I put together a concise MAP draft and attached the artifacts we normally share during evaluation. Summary below and attachments included.

Quick MAP (proposed):
1) Week 0: Mutual kickoff + roles (Redwood PM: Marissa, Security PO: Ben)
2) Week 1: Evidence intake — SOC 2 snapshot (we provide report summary + bridge letters); SIG/CAIQ matrix delivered; procurement/legal review DPA redline
3) Week 2-3: Technical deep dive and optional hosted vs private deployment checklist (scoping for EU residency)
4) Week 4: Finalize DPA + retention annex acceptance (90-day default, 30/90/365 options)
5) Week 5: Executive signoff and go/no-go (pilot start or contract execution)

Owners:
- Redwood security evidence & SIG/CAIQ matrix: Ben Carter
- MAP coordination & timelines: Sofia Ivanova / Marissa Cole
- Legal redline & DPA: Redwood Legal (cc'd via Doc link)

Attachments (attached to this email):
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 scope & date of last audit)
- sig-caaiq-matrix.xlsx (control-by-control mapping; notes for hosted vs private)
- DPA_redline_Livestream_v1.docx (initial redline based on typical bank requests)

A few notes: our SOC 2 report is scoped to data processing for hosted API; for Private deployments we provide an implementation checklist and can offer support for SOC-aligned controls in customer managed infra. Regarding retention: we include a retention annex in the DPA — the default for hosted is configurable per account, but standard options we see are 30, 90, 365. If you need EU residency, we can scope a private deployment or region-restricted hosting.

Next steps: If that layout looks good, can you confirm procurement's preferred retention bucket and whether your auditors need the full SOC 2 report (we can provide an assessor NDA + SOC 2 full report under NDA)

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

Quick internal ask: Ben, aim for a short bullet summary by EOD Wednesday (2027-11-03).
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security & retention questions

Thanks — notes below for the MAP / procurement Qs:

- SOC 2: Last audit completed 2027-06-10 (Type II). We can share a summary now; full report available under assessor NDA.
- SIG/CAIQ: Matrix attached covers hosted API by default; private deployment column includes control responsibilities and expected customer evidence. Key differences highlighted: key management (KMS access), network isolation, and logging retention owners.
- DPA / retention: standard retention annex gives three configurable buckets (30/90/365). For banking customers we recommend 90 as baseline; if you require EU residency we will recommend Redwood Private or region-locked hosting.
- Audit traces / escrow: We do offer a time-limited export of audit traces for customers on Dedicated or Private at contract termination; for hosted customers we provide a snapshot export under strict controls (48-72 hour SLA to package), but full escrow (long-term hosted storage under escrow) is not standard — legal will need to sign off on scope and costs.

I'll add inline comments to the SIG sheet and push a quick summary doc to the Drive link Sofia shared.

Ben Carter
Security Product Owner, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Sofia — thanks for the fast turnaround and Ben/Marissa for the clarifications. Procurement confirms 90-day retention as our preferred bucket for the pilot. A couple of follow-ups: 

1) Can you provide the assessor NDA template so our legal can get it in place with minimum friction?
2) For the audit trace export option, can you give a rough order-of-magnitude cost and whether that is a one-time fee vs annual? Our finance team will need that to evaluate the procurement path.
3) Our compliance lead asked whether we can get a short note explaining how you handle KV cache data vs request logs — the distinction matters for our retention annex.

If you can attach the NDA + the short KV-cache vs logs note, procurement will circulate the MAP internally and propose a kickoff for next Tuesday (2027-11-16).

Thanks — Ethan
